financial_risks.description: Uncertainty of global economic development, geopolitical instability, volatile currency fluctuations, inflation, interest rates
financial_risks.mitigation: Risk diversification, avoidance of regional and industry clustering, continuous monitoring and control by corporate finance and accounting

operational_risks.description: Geopolitical events, Middle East disruptions, pandemic or epidemic spread
operational_risks.mitigation: Updated back-up structures and business continuity plans

it_risks.risk_type: IT network availability and data security
it_risks.description: Risks related to IT network availability, IT data and security
it_risks.mitigation: Permanent monitoring of systems, redundant infrastructure, interlinked data centres with back-up structures

regulatory_risks.description: Increase of regulations, growing complexity and customer expectations, security requirements
regulatory_risks.mitigation: Consideration in planning of supply chain solutions and worldwide operations

fraud_risks.description: Fraud, intentional and unintentional violations of law and internal regulations
fraud_risks.mitigation: Comprehensive and worldwide staff training, network of compliance officers at regional and national levels

ai_positioning.evidence: Digital Ecosystem is a cornerstone of Roadmap 2026 strategy. Company emphasizes turning innovative technology, data, and automation into competitive advantages. Focus on data-based insights and digital platforms for supply chain solutions.
ai_positioning.summary_fr: Kuehne+Nagel positionne la technologie et l'automatisation comme éléments clés de sa stratégie Roadmap 2026, avec un accent particulier sur l'écosystème numérique et l'exploitation des données pour créer des avantages concurrentiels. L'IA apparaît comme un outil d'intégration dans les solutions de chaîne d'approvisionnement plutôt que comme un domaine stratégique central.
